evaluation.results_summary: The developer states that these models outperform many available open-source options.

possible_risks.description: Lack of model transparency is due to insufficient documentation of the model design, development, and evaluation process and the absence of insights into the inner workings of the model.
possible_risks.justification: Card reports only that the model outperforms many open-source options and gives no evaluation details, design, or training-data documentation for this checkpoint.

possible_risks.description: Proper documentation contains information about how a model's data was collected, curated, and used to train a model, including any synthetic data generation processes. Without proper documentation it might be harder to satisfactorily explain the behavior of the model.
possible_risks.justification: Card does not describe how training/fine-tuning data was collected or curated for Bellatrix-Tiny-1B-v2, only naming the base Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct.

possible_risks.description: Since foundation models can be used for many purposes, a model's intended use is important for defining the relevant risks of that model. As the use changes, the relevant risks might correspondingly change.
possible_risks.justification: Card states only text-to-text modality and open weights, with no intended-use or deployment-context definition, so relevant risks are underspecified.

specifications.model_size: 2.3 GiB of safetensors weights (2,471,645,608 bytes) in BF16

training_context.adaptations: The tuned model was created with supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning with human feedback.
